zh: 先完成当前工作，或点停止。
en: Finish your current task, or press Stop.

zh: 手里没有木材。
en: You are not carrying any wood.

zh: 这个箱子暂时不能使用。
en: This chest is unavailable right now.

zh: 附近没有空余的箱子。
en: There are no chests with space nearby.

zh: 找不到这个目标。
en: This target cannot be found.

zh: 目标不在这座岛上。
en: The target is on another island.

zh: 伙伴正在处理这个目标。
en: A companion is already working on this target.

zh: 这里不是树木。
en: This is not a tree.

zh: 这棵树正在重新生长，长大后再来砍。
en: This tree is regrowing. Come back when it is mature.

zh: 先安置手上拿着的东西。
en: Put away what you are holding first.

zh: 先给箱子留出位置。
en: Make some room in the chest first.

zh: 这里不是宅地。
en: This is not a home site.

zh: 房子已经盖好了。
en: The house is already complete.

zh: 先存好蘑菇再施工。
en: Store your mushrooms before building.

zh: 先搬些木材来；本阶段已交 %s / %s，已有投入会保留。
en: Bring some wood first. This stage has %s / %s; existing contributions are kept.

zh: 箱子里没有木材。
en: There is no wood in the chest.

zh: 暂不支持这个动作。
en: This action is not supported yet.

zh: 走不到目标旁边。
en: The target cannot be reached.

zh: 开始工作了。
en: Work has started.

zh: 已暂停，材料和进度都留着。
en: Paused. Materials and progress are kept.

zh: 连续伐木已停止，手中和地上的木材会保留。
en: Wood gathering stopped. Carried and dropped wood are kept.

zh: 本阶段已交料 %s / %s，还差 %s 根；之后可以接着搬。
en: This stage has %s / %s wood, with %s still needed. You can deliver more later.

zh: 送到 %s 根木材，手中剩余会保留。
en: Delivered %s wood. Anything left in your hands is kept.

zh: 当前阶段的木材已够，手中材料保留。
en: This stage has enough wood. You keep what you are carrying.

zh: 木材留在地上，暂时走不到。
en: The wood remains on the ground, out of reach for now.

zh: 木材已经收好了。
en: The wood is already stored.

zh: 背包已满，木材仍留在地上。
en: Your backpack is full. The wood stays on the ground.

zh: 箱子满了，木材还在手里。
en: The chest is full. The wood stays in your hands.

zh: 箱子暂时无法到达，木材还在手里。
en: The chest cannot be reached. The wood stays in your hands.

zh: 箱子满了，剩下的木材留在手里。
en: The chest is full. The remaining wood stays in your hands.

zh: 暂时走不到剩下的木材。
en: The remaining wood cannot be reached right now.

zh: 木材搬进箱子了。
en: The wood is in the chest.

zh: 走不到宅地。
en: The home site cannot be reached.

zh: 走不到剩余木材，已有投入会保留。
en: The remaining wood cannot be reached. Existing contributions are kept.

zh: 走不到宅地，木材还在手里。
en: The home site cannot be reached. The wood stays in your hands.

zh: 走不到箱子。
en: The chest cannot be reached.

zh: 地基里还有伙伴，材料已留好，等她走开再继续。
en: Someone is inside the foundation. The materials are safe; wait until they move.

zh: 房子盖好了。
en: The house is complete.

zh: 这一阶段做好了。
en: This stage is complete.

zh: 先结束当前工作。
en: Finish your current task first.

zh: 这里没有木材。
en: There is no wood here.

zh: 伙伴正在搬这堆木材。
en: A companion is hauling this wood.

zh: 木材不在这座岛。
en: The wood is on another island.

zh: 请选择宅地。
en: Choose a home site.

zh: 先走到房子所在的岛上。
en: Go to the island where the house is first.

zh: 先拿一捆木材来。
en: Pick up a bundle of wood first.

zh: 房子已经盖好，木材留在手里。
en: The house is complete. You keep the wood.

zh: 请先靠近到2格内，赠予不会自动移动任何人。
en: Come within 2 tiles first. Giving never moves anyone automatically.

zh: 先放好抱着的家具，避免原物资状态被覆盖。
en: Put down the furniture first, so its materials stay intact.

zh: 正在真实取放或处理物资，请空闲后再赠予。
en: You are handling materials. Wait until you are free before giving a gift.

zh: 这捆物资属于原工程的在途收据，先妥善处理后再赠予。
en: These materials belong to a delivery in progress. Settle that delivery before giving them.

zh: 真实物品已整单送达。
en: The whole gift has been delivered.

zh: 肚子饿了，先吃点东西再接新的工作吧。
en: You are hungry. Have something to eat before accepting new work.

zh: 农庄委托已暂停。
en: The farm order is paused.

zh: 已浇水的作物离线长到本批成熟；不会自动收获、补种或腐烂。
en: Watered crops matured for this batch while away. Nothing was harvested, replanted, or lost.

zh: 管理人已改变，请重新安排。
en: The manager changed. Please arrange the work again.

zh: 这片农庄由另一位伙伴管理，请主人先调整管理人。
en: Another companion manages this farm. Ask the host to change the manager first.

zh: 接着照料上次的农庄。
en: Continuing the previous farm order.

zh: 开始照料农庄。
en: Starting work on the farm.

zh: 农庄委托已接下；播种、浇水和搬运由游戏执行，生长时等待。
en: Farm order accepted. Planting, watering, and hauling run in the game; crop growth takes time.

zh: 先安置手上物品，或给背包留1格。
en: Put your items away, or leave 1 backpack slot free.

zh: 种子箱里没有这种种子。收获时会留种，可从收获箱取回。
en: There are no seeds of this kind in the seed chest. Harvesting keeps seeds; retrieve them from the harvest chest.

zh: 管理权限已改变。
en: Farm permissions changed.

zh: 等作物慢慢长大。
en: Waiting for the crops to grow.

zh: 这片田种满并浇好水了。
en: The field is fully planted and watered.

zh: 菜都收好了
en: All ripe crops are harvested

zh: 这轮农活完成了
en: This round of farm work is complete

zh: 农事暂时受阻。
en: Farm work is blocked for now.

zh: 正在田间照料。
en: Tending the field.

zh: 种子已经被取走。
en: The seeds were already taken.

zh: 走不到田边，种子还在手中。
en: The field cannot be reached. You keep the seeds.

zh: 地块已改变，种子保留。
en: The plot changed. You keep the seeds.

zh: 播下种子了，接下来浇一次水。
en: Seed planted. It needs one watering next.

zh: 地块已改变。
en: The plot changed.

zh: 浇好水了，会慢慢生长，离线也会长。
en: Watered. It will grow slowly, even while you are away.

zh: 这块田暂时不能收获。
en: This plot cannot be harvested yet.

zh: 背包空间不足，请先存箱。
en: Not enough backpack space. Store something first.

zh: 收成留在手里，暂时走不到箱子。
en: The harvest stays in your hands; the chest cannot be reached.

zh: 物品存进农庄箱子了。
en: The items are in the farm chest.

zh: 箱子满了，剩余物品还在手里。
en: The chest is full. You keep the remaining items.

zh: 箱子里的物品不足。
en: There are not enough items in the chest.

zh: 拿好了。
en: Picked up.

zh: 收成在手里，暂时走不到休憩处。
en: The harvest stays in your hands; the resting spot cannot be reached.

zh: 手里的收成不足。
en: You are not holding enough produce.

zh: 把自己种的花布置在田边了。
en: Flowers you grew are now decorating the field.

zh: 重新进入后，确认再继续农庄委托。
en: After returning to the game, confirm before continuing the farm order.

zh: 无效的出生点
en: Invalid spawn point

zh: 出生点不可通行
en: The spawn point is blocked

zh: 你
en: You

zh: 有栖
en: Kinabode

zh: 请在火边点击烧烤，先邀请伙伴再选择食物。
en: At the fire, choose Barbecue, invite companions, then choose food.

zh: 肚子饿了，先吃点东西再接新的工作吧。
en: You are hungry. Have something to eat before accepting new work.

zh: 这是伙伴自己的物品，请由物主操作或明确赠予。
en: These items belong to a companion. Their owner must use them or explicitly give them.

zh: 请由房屋主人布置自己的家。
en: Only the homeowner may furnish their home.

zh: 对弈进行中，先暂停棋局。
en: A match is running. Pause it first.

zh: 先结束集合或共同活动，再安排家园工程。
en: End the gathering or shared activity before starting a homestead project.

zh: 已有家园工程任务，请先明确停止或暂停。
en: You already have a homestead task. Stop or pause it explicitly first.

zh: 先暂停或离开棋桌，再安排其他行动。
en: Pause or leave the chess table before doing something else.

zh: 正举着鱼儿，先放入渔场或放生，再拿工具吧。
en: You are holding a fish. Place it in a pen or release it before taking tools.

zh: 原活动先暂停，准备好的东西保留。
en: The previous activity is paused. Prepared materials are kept.

zh: 正在参加烧烤活动，先由主人暂停或结束。
en: You are at a barbecue. The host must pause or end it first.

zh: 正在跟随你；先取消跟随，或由主人明确安排新任务。
en: Following you. Cancel following, or have the host assign a new task explicitly.

zh: 正在集合，先由主人解散或安排新活动。
en: A gathering is in progress. The host must dismiss it or arrange a new activity.

zh: 已暂停，材料和进度都留着。
en: Paused. Materials and progress are kept.

zh: 先暂停当前计划，再去钓鱼。
en: Pause your current plan before fishing.

zh: 先暂停农庄委托，再安排其他工作。
en: Pause the farm order before starting other work.

zh: 建屋计划正在进行；要安排别的事，请先暂停。
en: A house plan is active. Pause it before doing something else.

zh: 先把抱着的家具放下。
en: Put down the furniture first.

zh: 这座房子的计划已确定图纸；先取消计划再更换未开工图纸。
en: This house plan has chosen its blueprint. Cancel the plan before changing unstarted plans.

zh: 已开工的房子保留原图纸，不能直接替换。
en: Construction has begun. The original blueprint cannot be replaced.

zh: 这份图纸超出宅地。
en: This blueprint extends beyond the home site.

zh: 房屋会挡住现有物件。
en: The house would block existing objects.

zh: 图纸已选定，共需 %s 根木材。
en: Blueprint chosen. It needs %s wood in total.

zh: 背包满了，零碎仍留在手上，请先存箱。
en: Your backpack is full. Loose items stay in your hands; store something first.

zh: 先忙完手上的事。
en: Finish what you are doing first.

zh: 背包满了，请先存箱。
en: Your backpack is full. Store something first.

zh: 手里没有需要收起的零碎物品。
en: There are no loose items to put away.

zh: 零碎物品已收进背包；仍占原背包容量。
en: Loose items are in your backpack. They still count toward the same capacity.

zh: 主人安排了新的事情，原活动先暂停。
en: The host assigned something new. The previous activity is paused.

zh: 钓鱼配置无效。
en: The fishing settings are invalid.

zh: 这条鱼在烹调准备中，不能重复入场或放生；原实例会保留。
en: This fish is being prepared for cooking. It cannot be stocked or released again; the original fish is kept.

zh: 先收好鱼竿，再安置鱼儿。
en: Put away your fishing rod before placing the fish.

zh: 鱼儿已游进
en: The fish has entered

zh: ，你不用过去。
en: . You do not need to walk there.

zh: 带到海边再放生，或直接放入渔场吧。
en: Bring the fish to the coast to release it, or place it directly in a pen.

zh: 鱼儿游回了大海。
en: The fish swam back to sea.

zh: 到自然海岸，点动作里的钓鱼；渔场只养鱼。
en: Go to a natural coast and choose Fish in Actions. Pens only hold caught fish.

zh: 先完成当前行动，或停止后再钓鱼。
en: Finish or stop your current action before fishing.

zh: 先放好手里的物资，再拿鱼竿。
en: Put away your materials before taking the fishing rod.

zh: 先把举着的鱼儿放入渔场或放生。
en: Place the fish you are holding in a pen, or release it first.

zh: 先安置或放生现有鱼儿。
en: Place or release your current fish first.

zh: 先到海边，再试试钓鱼吧。
en: Go to the coast before trying to fish.

zh: 岸边有点挤，往旁边站一点再抛竿吧。
en: The shore is crowded. Step aside a little before casting.

zh: 这片海暂时安静，过会儿再来。
en: This sea is quiet for now. Come back later.

zh: 抛出鱼竿，等海里的惊喜。
en: Cast your rod and wait for a surprise from the sea.

zh: 先到海边，再邀请伙伴一起钓鱼吧。
en: Go to the coast before inviting companions to fish.

zh: 太饿了
en: Too hungry

zh: 还举着鱼
en: Holding a fish

zh: 手里拿着东西
en: Hands full

zh: 不在附近
en: Not nearby

zh: 正在忙
en: Busy

zh: 正在等你回应
en: Waiting for your reply

zh: 暂时找不到空闲岸位
en: No free shore spot found

zh: ，没来
en: did not come

zh: 海面暂时安静下来，先收竿。
en: The sea has quieted down. Putting the rod away.

zh: 钓到了%s倍身高的%s，选一片渔场安置它吧！
en: Caught a %s-times-life-size %s! Choose a pen for it.

zh: 发现册添了新的一页。
en: A new page in the discovery book.

zh: 这次岸边等待太久，先收好鱼竿。
en: The wait at this shore took too long. Putting the rod away.

zh: 先建好营火。
en: Build the campfire first.

zh: 正在走到火边。
en: Walking to the fire.

zh: 木材不够：背包 %s + 箱子 %s，需要 2
en: Not enough wood: backpack %s + storage %s; need 2

zh: 火生好了，选选吃什么吧。
en: The fire is lit. Choose something to eat.

zh: 只能烤主角手里待安置的鱼。
en: Only the player's pending fish can be grilled.

zh: 火上还有食物。
en: There is still food on the fire.

zh: 木材不够，需要 %d 木材。
en: You need %d wood.

zh: 烤鱼
en: Grilled Fish

zh: 鱼上火了，烤好后可以叫伙伴。
en: The fish is on the fire. Invite companions when it is ready.

zh: 先在火边生火。
en: Light the fire first.

zh: 食物正在烤，等这一轮好了再选。
en: Food is still cooking. Wait for this round before choosing again.

zh: 这次围炉记录满了；先结束这次，再生火继续，背包食物未扣除。
en: This fireside record is full. End this gathering, then light a new fire. Backpack food was not spent.

zh: 食材还不够，去采一些再来吧。
en: Not enough ingredients. Gather some first.

zh: 火快灭了，先添2木材。
en: The fire is fading. Add 2 wood first.

zh: 食物上架了，烤好了就一起吃。
en: Food is on the grill. Share it when it is ready.

zh: 她还在主岛，先一起坐船过来。
en: She is still on the main island. Bring her across first.

zh: 你离开了火边。
en: You left the fireside.

zh: 有人需要先离开围炉。
en: Someone needs to leave the fireside.

zh: 鱼凉了，未吃的食物浪费了。
en: The fish went cold. Uneaten food was wasted.

zh: 火慢慢熄灭了。
en: The fire slowly went out.

zh: 围炉动作已结束。
en: The fireside action has ended.

zh: 本次实际就餐已结束。
en: This meal has finished.

zh: 围炉已结束，未声称吃完。
en: The fireside ended. This does not mean the meal was finished.

zh: 停止围炉。
en: End the fireside.

zh: 伙伴先去处理别的事。
en: A companion went to do something else.
